name: io.github.CLNS-KR/grnt
title: GRNT — Korean Grant & Subsidy Intelligence
description: Grants, simplified. Korea personal-benefit and startup/SME grant eligibility from official public data: Gov24 condition codes (age, gender, income bracket, life stage, household) plus K-Startup and Bizinfo announcement requirements (business age, target, region, industry). Returns reasons, missing information, and source attribution.
